paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Pappa. Rabbi Zeira told him, “Go around by the Ladder of Tyre and enter before Rabbi Yaakov bar Idi” (and ask him whether he heard from Rabbi Yochanan his teacher; Bava Metzia 43b). It appears that he is Rabbi Abba the priest mentioned above. (But to me it appears that he is one of the sons of Rav Pappa the elder.) In Rav Adda bar Pappa’s name; in Rabbi Acha b.P.’s name; in Rabbi Chiyya b.P.’s name (see there). Rabbi Pinchas in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of the first chapter of Berakhot.
